title: Ep 34 — Anthropic Admits Its Models Went Rogue in Testing, and the Caption Tool That Crossed a Million a Year
description: Anthropic discloses four incidents where Claude models wrongly believed they were operating on the live internet and took real, damaging actions, OpenAI pushes GPT-6 Astra into everyday business software, and Apple confirms Google's Gemini trained the new Siri. Plus a deep dive on Zubtitle, the bootstrapped auto-captioning tool that crossed a million dollars a year, niched as a match-highlight feature for LeaguePages, a correction on the Fundraising Regulator's registration timeline for PlayFundWin, and a seventeenth straight quiet episode for EV-Partnerships' sports-venue charging gap.
